name: Barbarian
startingEquipment: Greataxe or any martial melee weapon
Two handaxes or any simple weapon

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, you gain bonus damage on melee attacks using Strength, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and advantage on Strength checks and saves. You can't cast spells while raging. Your rage lasts for 1 minute.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

features.name: Primal Path
features.description: Choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage: Path of the Berserker or Path of the Totem Warrior.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Path Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Primal Path.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Brutal Critical (1 die)
features.description: You can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

features.name: Path Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Primal Path.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: Your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Brutal Critical (2 dice)
features.description: You can roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit.

features.name: Path Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Primal Path.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Brutal Critical (3 dice)
features.description: You can roll three additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: You embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

name: Bard
startingEquipment: Rapier or longsword or any simple weapon
Lute or any other musical instrument

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality. You know two cantrips and four 1st-level spells of your choice from the bard spell list.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d6)
features.description: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. As a bonus action, choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die, a d6. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest (d6)
features.description: You can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points at the end of the short rest, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

features.name: Bard College
features.description: You delve into the advanced techniques of a bard college of your choice: the College of Lore or the College of Valor.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d8)
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die becomes a d8.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: You gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

features.name: College Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Bard College.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Song of Rest (d8)
features.description: Your Song of Rest die becomes a d8.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d10)
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die becomes a d10.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two more of your skill proficiencies to gain expertise.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: You have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any class, including this one. The spells you choose must be of a level you can cast.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Song of Rest (d10)
features.description: Your Song of Rest die becomes a d10.

features.name: College Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Bard College.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Choose two more spells from any class.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d12)
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die becomes a d12.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Song of Rest (d12)
features.description: Your Song of Rest die becomes a d12.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Choose two more spells from any class.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

name: Cleric
startingEquipment: Scale mail or leather armor or chain mail
Light crossbow and 20 bolts or any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: As a conduit for divine power, you can cast cleric spells. You know three cantrips and can prepare a number of cleric spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your cleric level.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose one domain related to your deity: Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, or War.

features.name: Channel Divinity (1/rest)
features.description: You gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain.

features.name: Turn Undead
features.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw.

features.name: Domain Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
features.description: When an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, it is instantly destroyed if its CR is at or below 1/2.

features.name: Channel Divinity (2/rest)
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests.

features.name: Domain Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 1 or lower.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: You can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 2)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 2 or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 3)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 3 or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 4)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 4 or lower.

features.name: Channel Divinity (3/rest)
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity three times between rests.

features.name: Domain Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
features.description: Your call for divine intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.

name: Druid
armorProficiencies: Shields (druids will not wear armor or use shields made of metal)
startingEquipment: Wooden shield or any simple weapon
Scimitar or any simple melee weapon

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast druid spells. You know two cantrips and can prepare a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: You can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice and regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest. You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). CR 1/4 or lower, no flying or swimming speed.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: You choose to identify with a circle of druids: the Circle of the Land or the Circle of the Moon.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement (CR 1/2, swim)
features.description: Your Wild Shape improves. You can transform into beasts with a CR of 1/2 or lower and can transform into beasts with a swimming speed.

features.name: Circle Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Druid Circle.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement (CR 1, fly)
features.description: You can transform into beasts with a CR of 1 or lower and can transform into beasts with a flying speed.

features.name: Circle Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Druid Circle.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Circle Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Druid Circle.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: The primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: You can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times. Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell.

name: Fighter
startingEquipment: Chain mail or leather armor, longbow, and 20 arrows
Martial weapon and shield or two martial weapons
Light crossbow and 20 bolts or two handaxes

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting. Choose one: Archery (+2 to ranged attack rolls), Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed weapon), Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice), Protection (impose disadvantage on attack against ally within 5 ft), or Two-Weapon Fighting (add ability modifier to off-hand attack damage).

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: You have a limited well of stamina. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Action Surge (one use)
features.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Martial Archetype
features.description: You choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques: Champion, Battle Master, or Eldritch Knight.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Martial Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Martial Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Indomitable (one use)
features.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Martial Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Martial Archetype.

features.name: Extra Attack (2)
features.description: You can attack three times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Indomitable (two uses)
features.description: You can use Indomitable twice between long rests.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Martial Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Martial Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Action Surge (two uses)
features.description: You can use Action Surge twice before a rest.

features.name: Indomitable (three uses)
features.description: You can use Indomitable three times between long rests.

features.name: Martial Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Martial Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Extra Attack (3)
features.description: You can attack four times whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Monk
toolProficiencies: One artisan's tool or one musical instrument

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: You gain the following benefits while unarmed or wielding only monk weapons and not wearing armor or wielding a shield: You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls, you can roll a d4 in place of normal damage, and when you use Attack action with unarmed strike or monk weapon, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Ki
features.description: You gain access to ki points equal to your monk level. You can spend these points to fuel various ki features. You regain all spent ki points when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

features.name: Patient Defense
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn.

features.name: Step of the Wind
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.description: You commit yourself to a monastic tradition: Way of the Open Hand, Way of Shadow, or Way of the Four Elements.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.description: You can use your reaction to deflect or catch the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. The damage you take is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: You can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point when you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Tradition Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Monastic Tradition.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Stillness of Mind
features.description: You can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Unarmored Movement Improvement
features.description: You gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

features.name: Purity of Body
features.description: You are immune to disease and poison.

features.name: Tradition Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Monastic Tradition.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.description: You learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.description: You gain proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: You suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged magically. You can still die of old age, however.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Tradition Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Monastic Tradition.

features.name: Empty Body
features.description: You can use your action to spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you also have resistance to all damage but force damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Perfect Self
features.description: When you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.

name: Paladin
startingEquipment: Martial weapon and shield or two martial weapons
Five javelins or any simple melee weapon

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: You can detect good and evil. As an action, you know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover. You can use this feature a number of times equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: You have a pool of healing power that can restore 5 hit points per paladin level. As an action, you can touch a creature and restore hit points from your pool, or spend 5 hit points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison affecting the creature.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a fighting style: Defense (+1 AC), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed weapon), Great Weapon Fighting (reroll 1s and 2s), or Protection (impose disadvantage on attack).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast paladin spells. You prepare spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level (rounded down).

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend, to a maximum of 6d8.

features.name: Divine Health
features.description: You are immune to disease.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.description: You swear the oath that binds you as a paladin forever: Oath of Devotion, Oath of the Ancients, or Oath of Vengeance. Each oath has a list of associated spells.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier. You must be conscious to grant this bonus. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Oath Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Sacred Oath.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.description: You are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry divine power with them. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.description: You can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier. You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Oath Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Sacred Oath.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Aura Improvements
features.description: The range of your Aura of Protection and Aura of Courage increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Oath Feature
features.description: You gain a capstone feature from your Sacred Oath.

name: Ranger
startingEquipment: Two shortswords or two simple melee weapons

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track your favored enemies, as well as on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. Choose a type of favored enemy: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Alternatively, you can select two races of humanoid as favored enemies.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: You are a master of navigating the natural world. Choose one type of favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the Underdark. When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check related to your favored terrain, your proficiency bonus is doubled.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a fighting style: Archery (+2 to ranged attacks), Defense (+1 AC), Dueling (+2 damage with one-handed weapon), or Two-Weapon Fighting (add ability modifier to off-hand damage).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast ranger spells. You know a number of ranger spells shown in the Spells Known column of the Ranger table.

features.name: Ranger Archetype
features.description: You choose an archetype that you strive to emulate: Hunter, Beast Master, or Gloom Stalker.

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.description: You can use your action and expend one ranger spell slot to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the spell slot you expend, you can sense whether aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead are present within 1 mile of you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
features.description: You can choose one additional favored enemy, and one additional favored terrain.

features.name: Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

features.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
features.description: You choose one additional favored terrain.

features.name: Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
features.description: You choose one additional favored enemy.

features.name: Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: You gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it. You are also aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet of you, provided that the creature isn't hidden from you and you aren't blinded or deafened.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: You become an unparalleled hunter of your enemies. Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or the damage roll of an attack you make against one of your favored enemies. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

name: Rogue
startingEquipment: Shortbow and quiver of 20 arrows or shortsword
Burglar's pack, dungeoneer's pack, or explorer's pack
Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of your skill proficiencies and your proficiency with thieves' tools. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1d6)
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. The attack must use a finesse or a ranged weapon. You don't need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: If your attack misses a target within range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Sorcerer
startingEquipment: Light crossbow and 20 bolts or any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast sorcerer spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. You know four cantrips and two 1st-level spells from the sorcerer spell list.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose a sorcerous origin, which describes the source of your innate magical power: Draconic Bloodline, Wild Magic, or Divine Soul.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You have 2 sorcery points, and you gain more as you reach higher levels. You can use sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: You gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You learn two Metamagic options: Careful Spell, Distant Spell, Empowered Spell, Extended Spell, Heightened Spell, Quickened Spell, Subtle Spell, or Twinned Spell.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

name: Warlock
startingEquipment: Light crossbow and 20 bolts or any simple weapon
Leather armor, any simple weapon, and two daggers

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: You have struck a bargain with an otherworldly being: the Fiend, the Archfey, or the Great Old One. Your choice grants you features at 1st level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: You can cast warlock spells using Charisma. Warlock spell slots are all the same level and you regain all expended spell slots when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: You learn two eldritch invocations of your choice. When you gain certain warlock levels, you gain additional invocations. Examples: Agonizing Blast, Armor of Shadows, Devil's Sight, Mask of Many Faces, Misty Visions.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you. Choose: Pact of the Chain (familiar), Pact of the Blade (summon weapon), or Pact of the Tome (Book of Shadows with cantrips).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Eldritch Invocation
features.description: You learn an additional eldritch invocation.

features.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: You can draw on your inner reserve of mystical power while entreating your patron to regain expended spell slots. You can spend 1 minute entreating your patron for aid to regain all your expended spell slots from your Pact Magic feature. Once you regain spell slots with this feature, you must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast wizard spells using Intelligence. You have a spellbook containing six 1st-level wizard spells of your choice. You prepare a number of wizard spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + your wizard level.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.description: You choose an arcane tradition, shaping your practice of magic: School of Evocation, School of Abjuration, or School of Divination.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a 1st-level wizard spell and a 2nd-level wizard spell that are in your spellbook. You can cast those spells at their lowest level without expending a spell slot when you have them prepared.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: You gain mastery over two powerful spells and can cast them with little effort. Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these spells prepared, they don't count against the number of spells you have prepared, and you can cast each of them once at 3rd level without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
